items.requirement_zh: 提交方案需包含完整的城市设计文本
items.requirement_en: Submission must include complete urban design text
items.evidence_zh: proposal.md 包含13章完整内容，覆盖设计依据、范围、产业、空间、交通、市政、分期等完整框架
items.evidence_en: proposal.md contains 13 chapters covering design basis, scope, industry, spatial layout, transport, utilities, phasing

items.requirement_en: Spatial data must be provided in GeoJSON format
items.evidence_zh: geometry/目录下包含9个GeoJSON图层：site_boundary, key_areas, land_use, buildings, roads, green_space, public_space, constraints, phasing
items.evidence_en: geometry/ directory contains 9 GeoJSON layers: site_boundary, key_areas, land_use, buildings, roads, green_space, public_space, constraints, phasing

items.requirement_en: Design drawings must be provided in PNG/PDF format
items.evidence_en: assets/figures/ contains 5 PNG diagrams; drawings/ contains A3 booklet and A0 board PDFs

items.evidence_zh: 根目录包含proposal.md（中文）和proposal.en.md（英文），所有元数据均为双语
items.evidence_en: Root directory contains proposal.md (Chinese) and proposal.en.md (English); all metadata is bilingual

items.evidence_zh: manifest.json包含完整的包信息、文件清单、双语元数据
items.evidence_en: manifest.json contains complete package info, file inventory, and bilingual metadata

items.evidence_zh: agent.json说明智能体类型、使用工具、人工审核范围
items.evidence_en: agent.json describes agent type, tools used, and human review scope

items.evidence_zh: metrics.json包含6大类指标体系，基于新空间经济学框架设定
items.evidence_en: metrics.json contains 6 categories of metrics based on New Spatial Economics framework

items.evidence_zh: assumptions.json列出22条关键假设，涵盖边界、数据、政策、技术等维度
items.evidence_en: assumptions.json lists 22 key assumptions covering boundary, data, policy, technology dimensions

items.evidence_zh: sources.json列出18个数据来源，包括政府公开数据、学术文献、实地调研
items.evidence_en: sources.json lists 18 data sources including government open data, academic literature, field research

items.evidence_zh: self_check.json包含14项检查，总体通过，明确列出临时边界阻断项
items.evidence_en: self_check.json contains 14 checks, overall pass, clearly lists provisional boundary blocker

items.requirement_en: All spatial boundaries marked as provisional
items.evidence_zh: assumptions.json明确说明边界为概念示意；self_check.json列出provisional_boundary阻断项；方案文本中多次声明边界为示意
items.evidence_en: assumptions.json clearly states boundaries are conceptual; self_check.json lists provisional_boundary blocker; proposal text repeatedly states boundaries are illustrative

items.requirement_zh: 设计建议标注为概念建议
items.requirement_en: Design recommendations marked as conceptual suggestions
items.evidence_zh: 方案文本中所有设计建议均标注为概念性建议，不构成官方规划承诺
items.evidence_en: All design recommendations in proposal text are marked as conceptual suggestions and do not constitute official planning commitments

items.evidence_zh: 方案明确标注为AI辅助生成的概念方案，不代表任何政府部门意见
items.evidence_en: Proposal clearly marked as AI-assisted conceptual design and does not represent any government department's opinion
